goal: Connect one bounded Alice-aligned decision, independent consequence and scoped revision episode in FloRA without building PE or MFM.
procedure: Implement one local semantic authority over native tracked transactions. Stage authenticated objects; publish evidence, history, heads, receipts and work atomically. Release storage handles before model calls. Retain complete supplied packets and independently activate exact proposals. Separate owner action, actor acknowledgement and independently measured outcomes. Execute a file-based mixed-goal world and later judgment in a fresh process. Review adversarial inputs, reproduce missing guarantees, follow eight diagnosis steps, and test original failures with positive controls. Inspect actual producer seams before claiming model integration.
authority: Owner approved the continuity redesign and bounded prototype, required external model ownership and mandatory diagnosis. No canonical Alice cutover or model construction.
validation: 35 tests passed on real pinned RocksDB in network-disabled local Linux ARM64 Docker: 9 native/configuration, 7 store, 15 kernel, 4 connected episodes. Actual original bytes, synthetic world mutation, independent reader and fresh-process judgment were exercised. Atomic host/self rollback and source-person revision refusal passed. Review REDs reproduced uncited exposure leakage, time-only stale state and pre-action or wrongly bound outcome evidence. All corrected and original failures retained. A missing contract mount was diagnosed as setup, not a storage failure.
failure_or_lesson: Declared citations do not cover all data influence: record every offered input separately for withdrawal. Transaction generation does not detect time-only validity changes: carry the valid-time horizon through judgment, approval and dispatch. Observation chronology must bind capture, exact dispatch and exact mission criterion; the trusted observer still measures truth. Mechanics doubles cannot establish learning or revision benefit over rereading outcomes. A response digest is not the full native model packet. Existing limited model bridges must not silently flatten rich semantics.
